1. Prior to using the Towing mode, please plan your route appropriately to allow for the reduction in range from towing 
2. When using the Towing mode, please strictly abide by all relevant laws and regulations and be sure to connect the indicators of the towed device 
3. Please ensure that the weight of the towed equipment does not exceed the maximum towing weight specified in the Manual to avoid safety risks caused by overloading the vehicle 
4. For safety purposes, once the Towing mode is activated, the vehicle's acceleration performance and maximum speed will be adjusted; other functions including ADAS and park assist will be restricted 
5. When towing, please choose as flat a road as possible; avoid using the Towing mode on wet, icy or steep or wading roads. Do not brake or turn sharply while driving 
6. Do not use the Towing mode without activating this feature. Otherwise the vehicle may be damaged 
7. The user shall be responsible for legal liability or vehicle damage caused by failure to comply with laws and regulations or vehicle operating instructions
